decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY changing the piston-end arrangement to secure the bushing at the sliding end with the rod nut; no additional update or removal is required.
The revised bushing movement and retention arrangement does not necessarily change the specified shaft stock, diameter, keyway, locking-nut thread, or bushing-space width.
The bushing guidance and retention decision does not change the premachining, welding, or final-machining sequence.
The mechanical arrangement change does not alter the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The source changes how the bushing is retained and guided but does not change its CuSn12 material or any other material specification.
The bushing arrangement is unrelated to the required 45-degree angle between the lug hole axes.
The model must reflect the revised design, but the requirement to deliver a 3D shaft assembly model remains unchanged.
The source supplies design content to incorporate into the drawings but does not change the requirement to provide the manufacturing drawing set.
The source does not introduce, remove, or change any technical-dimension or annotation requirement.
